title: Perfect & Future Passive
description: Learn advanced passive forms with perfect and future tenses

explain.ta: Perfect மற்றும் future passive forms மிகவும் formal மற்றும் professional contexts-ல் பயன்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன. Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle ('The work has been completed'). Past perfect passive: had been + past participle ('The work had been completed'). Future passive: will be + past participle ('The work will be completed'). இந்த forms business reports, academic writing, மற்றும் formal announcements-ல் அதிகம் காணப்படுகின்றன.
explain.en: Perfect and future passive forms are used in formal and professional contexts. Present perfect passive: has/have been + past participle ('The work has been completed'). Past perfect passive: had been + past participle ('The work had been completed before the deadline'). Future passive: will be + past participle ('The project will be finished next week'). These forms are common in business reports, academic writing, and formal announcements.

examples.en: The work has been completed successfully.
The project will be finished next month.
The documents have been reviewed by the manager.
The building will be opened next year.
The report had been submitted before the deadline.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
The meeting will be held on Friday.
The issue had been resolved before we arrived.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The new policy will be introduced next week.
options: The new policy has been introduced next week.
The new policy will be introduced next week.
The new policy had been introduced next week.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The task had been completed before noon.
options: The task has been completed before noon.
The task will be completed before noon.
The task had been completed before noon.

speakSentences.en: The event will be organized next month.
The payment had been made before the due date.
